Preserve the Node editor's selected component expansion mode across task selection changes and apply it to the newly selected node.

Implemented in commit `6331198` and live in the restarted service. Collapsed, expanded and smart modes retain their behavior across repeated Task graph selections. Verified in the live UI as well as the recorded regression.

Validation: exact before/after recordings and focused editor regressions pass. The full checkpoint passed build, type, model, unit and integration checks; browser results were 379 passed and one pre-existing CRLF/LF failure in private-space-recovery-ui.spec.ts. Report: `.harness/checkpoints/run-zMLbCh/report.json`. Evidence is attached.
